reviewRationale.no-unsanitized/property: Exact DOM sinks were traced to DOMPurify/sanitizeSvg/sanitizeMath output, escaped text, fixed local templates, or vetted renderer output; hostile-content and CSP tests cover the active sinks.
reviewRationale.security/detect-non-literal-fs-filename: Executed tooling only reads or writes paths anchored below the repository, generated coverage/package directories, or an explicit local report path; none are reachable from rendered document content.
reviewRationale.security/detect-non-literal-regexp: Dynamic expressions use escaped literal search text or fixed parser delimiters and are bounded by local document limits.
reviewRationale.security/detect-object-injection: Findings are bounded array/tuple iteration, Map/locale lookups, parser token access, or state keys rather than attacker-selected object prototype writes.
reviewRationale.security/detect-unsafe-regex: Expressions use terminator-excluding classes or bounded local inputs; focused long-input tests cover the parser expressions flagged by the heuristic.
